Commentary.Commentary: So, that's it from us for today's game. Today's result ensures that we will have a new champion in this edition. Will it be the hosts England or do India have another incredible performance left in the tank? Join us on 23rd July 2017 at 1030 local, 0930 GMT for the all-important World Cup final at Lord's. Till then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

Meg Lanning says that the innings by Harmanpreet Kaur was incredible and congratulates India. Adds that Blackwell was hitting quite well but they didn't get the right start. Calls it a disappointing game.

Mithali Raj lauds Harmanpreet Kaur's innings and also the bowlers for doing well under pressure. Opines that her team has shown character in the tournament by bouncing back from a loss with clinical victories. Feels that her side has quality players and is happy that different people have stepped up in different matches. Expresses confidence in her bowling unit. Doesn't provide a definite answer on Kaur's fitness although she stresses on the fact that the players are excited for the World Cup final and to play at Lord's.

Harmanpreet Kaur is the unanimous choice for the Player of the Match. She is all smiles and says that she is really proud of her innings. Adds that she is looking forward to the final. Also praises her teammates and thanks the support staff.

India's bowlers had a fairly good outing. They started brilliantly and although they were undone by Villani and Blackwell, the bowlers kept their nerves at the crucial moments to pick wickets regularly. Having the cushion of some extra runs on the board also helped their cause. Goswami and Pandey were the pick of the bowlers with 2 scalps apiece while Yadav picked a 3-fer despite being expensive. Earlier in the day, a Kaur masterclass helped India post an intimidating total that proved too many for the Aussies in the end. Presentations in a bit.

A comfortable win for India in the end. Blackwell's sensational assault did give them some jitters although the required run rate was always hard to control for the Australians. The run chase of 282 was tough and the early wickets made it tougher but Villani's counterattack gave life to the innings. She and Perry stitched a valuable stand to put the chase on track but their dismissals triggered a collapse that all but sealed the game. At 169/9, it seemed only a matter of time but Blackwell wasn't done. She played an incredible knock to wade into the Indian bowlers. However, in the end, it was a bridge too far for her.

OUT! Bowledddd! A flatter ball around leg, skidding through the surface, Blackwell advances down the track and tries to whip across the line. But she fails to make any connection and finds her stumps getting rattled. The Indian girls jump in delight. They win by 36 runs and book a place in the final of the ICC Women's World Cup, 2017!
Too full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler who misfielded and conceded a run. Blackwell retains strike.
A googly around middle, Alex moves back and plays a late cut. Finds cover-point.
FOUR! Boom! A friendly full toss on middle, Blackwell shimmies down the track and slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Keeping the chase alive, Blackwell.
Short and on off, cut to sweeper cover for a single.
Wrong 'un, fuller and on off, Blackwell hammers it down to long on where Veda does well to stop it on one bounce. A single taken.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched to covers where Raj made a good stop.
Stat - This is now the highest 10th wicket partnership in Women's World Cup history.
Shikha Pandey cannot bowl yet, she was off the field. Poonam Yadav to bowl. 44 needed off 18 balls.
Jumps out of the crease and heaves it off the inner half of the bat to backward square leg. A single taken.
FOUR! Blackwell runs into the 80s! A low full toss on middle, Alex advances down the track, goes down on one knee and smashes it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Turning down the leg side, played behind square leg for one.
Shortish for the third time, outside off, Beams stays back and cuts it through the gap between short third man and point for a couple of runs.
Short again, around off, Blackwell pulls it with the spin to deep square leg for a single.
Short and angling down the leg side, Blackwell gets down on one knee and helps it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Veda Krishnamurthy to bowl for the first time today.
Lands it full and on off, Beams pushes it from the front foot to point.
Full and around off, driven down to long off for a single. 55 needed off 25 balls.
FOUR! High full toss on middle, Blackwell turns inside the crease and eases it behind square leg for another boundary.
Fullish and on middle and leg, Blackwell makes room and drills it straight down to mid off.
Length ball on off, Alex moves back to make space but mistimes her punch shot to the off side.
50-run stand between Blackwell and Beams.
FOUR! Past mid off. Full and following the batsman down the leg side, Blackwell still manages to unfurl a lovely off drive for a boundary.
Jhulan Goswami is back on. This last wicket partnership will be frustrating India. Blackwell is not going down easily. 64 needed from 30 balls.
Tossed up and around leg, played off the pads to short fine leg. Dot ball to end an expensive over.
Short and flat on off, it's punched through covers for a single.
SIX! Another one! Blackwell is not letting it go easily. Once again she is down the track in a flash and clobbers it handsomely over the bowler's head.
SIX! High and beautiful! Floated full ball on middle, Blackwell skips down the track and launches it over the bowler's head for a maximum. 80m on the radar!
Flatter and on the pads, nudged behind square leg for a single. A direct hit at the bowler's end but no harm done.
Walks down the track and lofts it over mid on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, cut through point for a couple of runs. Good diving stop by Deepti in the deep. 78 needed off 36 balls!
Floated full ball on off, played from the front foot to covers.
Flighted leg spinner on off, Beams gets forward and pushes it off the outside edge to short third man.
Short and outside off, punched from the crease to sweeper cover for one.
24th ODI fifty for Blackwell.
FOUR! Against the run of play, Blackwell has scored a fifty. Battling alone. An excellent sweep shot by her, wide of short fine leg for a boundary. 200 up for Australia!
Slower through the air, short and wide outside off, it's slapped through covers for a single.
Poonam Yadav is back on.
SIX! Boom! Another charge from Alex, she is down to the pitch of the ball in a flash and dispatches it over long on for a biggie.

FOUR! Nice shot! Blackwell not going down without a fight. Gives the charge to the bowler and hammers it over the bowler's head. Veda moves across to her left from long on but it drops in front of her and bounces over to cross the rope.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it from the inner half of the bat.
Flatter and shorter on off, Beams punches it off her back foot to point.
Loopy full ball on off, Blackwell gets down the track and towers it over mid off. It falls safely in the deep and they take a single.
Short and turning away from the batsman, cut through point for a couple of runs.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it back.
Strides forward and pushes it with the turn to covers.
Floated ball on off, Beams presents a straight bat in defense.
Flighted and around leg, Blackwell sweeps it fine down the leg side and Mansi Joshi (sub) chases it from short fine leg. Does well to stop it just before the rope and saves a couple.
FOUR! Fine shot! Blackwell makes space by staying leg side of the delivery and bludgeons it through extra cover for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Shortish and on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Quicker and flatter outside off, a late cut by Blackwell and it races fine down to third man for a boundary.
Kristen Beams is the last batter.

OUT! Slower full ball on middle, Schutt steps down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket. Makes fine connection but not good enough to clear the fielder in the deep. A straightforward catch to Goswami who accepts it calmly. India just one wicket away from getting into the final.
Short ball on middle, a mistimed pull shot to deep square leg for a run.
Flatter ball on off, Blackwell winds up for a big shot across the line but gets a bottom edge.
Deepti Sharma is back on.
A tossed up ball, Schutt tries to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but probably it pitched outside leg. Nothing from the umpire.
Just short of long on. Blackwell mistimes her lofted shot and Meshram (sub) comes running in but it drops in front of her. Maybe, a dive was needed.
FOUR! Poor delivery, short and in the line of the stumps, Blackwell uses the depth of the crease well and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary.
Advances down the track and helps it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. Dot ball.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back.
Tickles it off his pads to fine leg for a single.
Chips it over mid on for a single.
Fullish on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
FOUR! Wow, that's some shot. Too full and around off, Alex goes hard at it and drills it straight back past the bowler for a boundary down the ground.
Megan Schutt is the new batsman.

OUT! Run out at the non-striker's end. Full and angling into the batsman, Blackwell walks down the track and pushes it firmly back towards the bowler. Goswami gets her hand on it in the followthrough and it gets deflected onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. Jess Jonassen is backing up way too much and is run out. Unfortunate way to get dismissed. End is nigh for Australia.
Yorker on off, Blackwell digs it out off the outer half of the bat to keeper. It rolls to Verma.
Batting Powerplay taken.
Walks down the track to take it on the full and eases it to long on for a run.
Floated and full outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Jess Jonassen is in next.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Poonam gets lucky with this wicket. Short and wide outside off, spinning away, Gardner rocks back to punch but it takes the toe end of the bat and loops in the air at covers. Mithali Raj stationed there makes no mistake. Australia continue to slip further, have lost 4 for 26 now.
Wide! Tossed up but down the leg side, Gardner tries to sweep but misses.
Another sweep shot, this time through backward square leg for a run.
Gets down on one knee but sweeps it straight to the short fine leg fielder.
Nearly a return catch! Flighted full ball on middle, it's chipped back towards the bowler but it doesn't carry.
Very full and on middle, worked quietly in the big gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish and on off, stroked from the back foot through covers for a single.
Pitches it full and outside off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
Ashleigh Gardner is in next.

OUT! Another bowling change brings another wicket. Fuller in length around off, Healy tries to go up and over mid on but gets it off the toe end. It lobs in the air and Shikha Pandey takes a comfortable catch inside the ring. Australia reeling.
Good length ball on off, Alex jumps out of the crease and taps it down to cover-point for a quick single.
Fullish and on off, defended off the front foot to mid off.
Jhulan Goswami is back on.
FOUR! Clears the infield! Healy steps out to that one and chips it down the ground. Easily over mid off and the ball races to the fence. Much-needed boundary for the Aussies.
Slightly short outside off, rocks back to cut but gets a faint edge towards short third man.
Drifting in from outside off, gets across and sweeps it hard to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and outside off, steps out and jams it to cover.
Loopy on a length outside off, stays back for the cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Floated outside off, stays back and chops the cut towards short third man for a single.
Shortish and outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover. WICKET MAIDEN FOR INDIA.
Stat - This is the third time Ellyse Perry has got out to Shikha Pandey in ODIs, the most against any bowler. Bunny.
Another fuller ball on middle and leg, leans across and eases it to mid on.
Fullish ball around middle, leans across and drives it towards mid on.
Full and on the stumps, driven towards mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and works it gently towards mid-wicket.
Alyssa Healy in next.
Drinks break.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Is that the final nail in the coffin for Australia? On a length wider outside off, Perry tries to run it down to third man but is undone by the extra bounce. Gets a healthy edge through to Verma who grabs it with ease. The Indians will breathe easy now as the last of the big batters is gone. There is some more depth in the batting for Australia but the big guns have left. India firmly in control now as 142 more runs are needed from 95 balls.
Shikha Pandey returns for another spell.
Slightly short outside off, stays back and cuts it towards point but straight to the fielder. Slight fumble allows the single.
Flighted on off stump, driven to long on for a single.
Quicker ball around middle, hangs back and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flighted outside off, uses his feet and drives it to long off for a single.
Drifting in from around off, gets back and adjusts to work with the turn towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on a length around off, too close to cut and Perry chops it towards short third man.
Deepti Sharma is back on.
Flighted outside off, checks her drive towards the mid off fielder.
Full and outside off, leans into it and drives to long off for a single.
The googly that doesn't turn much, Blackwell chops the cut towards short third man for a single.
Drifting in from around middle, once again Blackwell steps out and works it to long on for a run.
Flighted around middle, steps out and powers it to long on for a single.
A bit short outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Almost dragged on! Drifting in from around off, Blackwell looks to play it square on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full and outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
On middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven down to long off for a single.

OUT! VILLANI FALLS! She cannot believe it, the Australian camp cannot believe it. Massive, massive blow this to the defending champions. She steps out for the lofted shot to go over mid on but couldn't middle it well. Spooned it towards Mandhana who took the catch comfortably at mid on. The Indians are totally pumped, they know how big this wicket is. Another 156 off 113 balls still needed as Alex Blackwell walks out to bat.
Flatter outside off, sits back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Drifting in from around off stump, gets across to that one and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. They thought of the second run but decide against it.
Drifting in from outside off, steps out and drills it past the bowler to long off for a single.
In the air, doesn't carry! Villani uses her feet to loft it down the ground but chips it aerially towards long off. Well short of the fielder as the batsmen cross.
Floated wider outside off, keeps a bit low as Villani misses the reverse sweep.
100-run stand between Perry and Villani!
Floated outside off, a bit short and Villani slaps it to sweeper cover for a single. Top partnership, this!
Drifting in from outside off, slapped off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Slightly short and outside off, chops the cut to the off side.

FOUR! Perry joins in the fun! Flighted on leg stump, uses her feet well and lofts it over wide mid on region. Nicely struck and it races to the fence for a boundary. She can switch gears whenever she wants to.
Flatter outside off, rocks back and slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted wider outside off, steps out for the big shot but then adjusts to pat it towards cover.
Looped up outside off, reaches out and dabs it to the off side.
Loopy and outside off, gets back and punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! GREAT SHOT! Villani is on the rampage at the moment. Goes for the reverse sweep and connects really well to beat backward point. No protection in the deep and it races to the fence.
Looped up well around off, stays back and punches it towards point.
Loopy and around middle, gets across and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Floated outside off, gets back and punches it through the covers for a single.
Poonam Yadav is brought back into the attack. This partnership is causing headaches to India. They need a breakthrough.

ALMOST A CHANCE! Almost carried to the fielder. Villani steps out for the lofted stroke but skews it towards long off where Mandhana charges forward with a dive but cannot reach to the ball. Brace taken.
Perry is calm for now, pulls the half-tracker to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Make that four dots! Some pressure created by Gayakwad. Flatter outside off, Perry punches it towards cover. Interesting to see how Perry will respond.
Flighted outside off, steps out and checks her push towards cover. Three dots in a row.
Drifting in from around off, gets back and works it towards mid-wicket.
Drifting in from around middle, Perry stays back and defends it towards the leg side.
Drifting in from around middle, punched off the back foot to long on for a single.
Floated around off, gets across and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.

FOUR! Runs bleeding now for India! It's Villani doing the damage at the moment. Sweeps it powerfully over backward square leg and finds the fence with ease. Once it cleared the infield, it was always a boundary. Can Villani replicate what Kaur did earlier today?? She is certainly on course.
Flatter outside off, Villani is beaten on the cut as she is cramped up a bit.

FOUR! Quick hands and another boundary to Villani! Not that short but she uses the depth of the crease well to essay the late cut. Almost took it from the keeper's gloves as it races to the third man fence for a boundary.
Floated outside off, reaches out and drives it to long off for a single.
3rd ODI fifty for Elyse Villani!
FOUR! Valiant Villani! What a counterattack this is! Steps out to this one and lifts it comfortably over wide mid off. Clobbers the daylights out of it and the ball rockets to the fence.
Slower and a touch short on off stump, Perry hangs back and whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Slight fumble but they eventually decide against the second run.
Looped up on off stump, Perry defends it well from the crease.
Flatter outside off, stays back and punches it towards cover for a single.

FOUR! Back to back boundaries! Villani seems determined as she sends another to the fence. Gets across to this flatter ball and sweeps it powerfully to the deep square leg fence. She is picking the gaps really well.
FOUR! Up and over! Villani puts on her dancing shoes once more and lofts this cleanly over mid off. Clears the infield comfortably, one bounce past the ropes for a boundary.
Drifting in from outside off, gets back and glides it to short third man.
Continues to come down the track, shorter in length and she adjusts well to slap it to deep mid-wicket. Just a single.
Full and outside off, steps out again and taps it to the off side.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Villani is unaffected by the pressure and continues to play her shots. Steps out to this and drills the inside out drive through extra cover. Long off put in a desperate slide moving to her left but in vain.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Villani goes for the sweep but misses. Verma whips off the bails in a flash but Villani's foot had gone nowhere.
Flatter on off stump, sits back and tucks it towards the vacant gap at mid-wicket as they take a single. Gayakwad herself gets to it and tidies up.
Drifting in from around middle, Villani steps out and works it towards mid-wicket where Gayakwad dives to her left to make a fine stop.
Tossed up nicely around middle, stays back and adjusts well to nudge it on the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, leans forward and digs it out to the off side.

50-run stand between Perry and Villani! This stand has brought the Australian chase back on the track somewhat. Elyse Villani, in particular, has looked fluent and is getting good support from Ellyse Perry. Still a long way to go.
Slower and a bit short outside off, crashed off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy full toss outside off, Villani uses his feet and pats it towards mid off. Probably surprised by the height on the full toss.
Tossed up outside off, steps out and takes it on the full. Drives it towards long off for a single.
Loopy and around middle, steps out and takes it on the full. Slaps it to long on for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, gets back and punches it towards point.
Mid-wicket drops back and square leg comes up.
Floated outside off, driven sweetly to short cover where Mithali puts in a fine diving stop.
Loopy and outside off, reaches out and taps it towards cover.
Drifting in from outside off, gets back and dabs it past backward point for a brace.
Floated around off, the arm ball skids through and Perry gets her bat down just in time. Stabbed to cover.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back on.
Drinks break....
Jumps out of the crease and yorks herself. Does well eventually to dig it out.
Uses her feet to take it on the full but hits it straight to mid off.
Excellent line this time, loopy and around off, Villani gets forward and pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Villani has been positive from the time she has come and races away to 33 with this boundary. Tossed up ball landing around leg, Elyse gets down on one knee and sweeps it behind square leg.
Flighted full ball on middle, spinning away, Perry gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Starts with a long hop on middle, Villani rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Poonam Yadav to bowl her loopy leggies. She has the best economy rate in ICC Women's World Cup, 2017.
Turns it off his pads through backward square leg for a single. 14 runs off the over!
FOUR! That's a powerful shot! A tossed up ball on off, too full in length, fancy footwork by Villani as she dismisses it inside out over extra cover for a boundary.
Flighted off spinner on off, flicked with the spin to mid-wicket.
Dances down to the pitch of the delivery and forces it down to long on for a run.
Five wides! Quicker and fuller fired down the leg side, Perry failed to sweep and the keeper also failed to collect it. It sped away to the fence. Bonus runs for Australia.
Fullish and on off, driven down to long off for one.
Flighted ball on middle, a full toss, it's swept to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. A poor throw from the deep otherwise it could have been a tight second run.
Deepti Sharma is back on.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Angling into the batsman, around off, Villani pushes it straight back and the bowler tries to stop it. Fails to do so cleanly and it goes off her right hand towards the umpire behind. The official does well to jump and avoid getting hit.

Harmanpreet Kaur is yet to take the field in the second innings. Understandable as she was struggling with cramps during the later part of her astonishing knock. India will want to nurse her, considering the value she adds to this side.
Pushed to the cover region by Elyse. Dot ball.
FOUR! Uppish but safe! A half-volley outside off, Villani leans forward and plays a nice looking square drive. That's in the air for a moment but goes well past the point fielder for a boundary.
Fullish and angling in, Elyse is on the front foot as he pushes it to mid on.
Serves it full and outside off, Villani tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shortish on off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Uses her feet again and pushes it down the ground for a single. The long off fielder cuts it off.
Short and outside off, cut through the line but straight to point.
Mid off drops back.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Flighted full ball on off, Villani jumps out of the crease and hammers it uppishly to mid off. Shikha Pandey inside the ring jumps to take the catch over her head but it bursts out of her hands and goes to the fence. Tough one!
Quicker and on middle, Perry gets back and tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Long hop to start with, around off, it's pulled down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is introduced into the attack. She is fresh from a fifer against New Zealand.
Villani guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Angling in a length ball on off, Elyse defends from the crease.
FOUR! That's gone through point! Shortish length ball outside off, Villani advances down the track and whacks it through point. Sloppy by Gayakwad manning that region as she lets it under her hands.
Villani has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Full and landing around off, moving back in from the seam, Villani tries to flick but misses and is rapped on the pads. The bowler gets excited for a while but then realizes it to be going down the leg side.
Gentle length delivery in the region outside off, Villani allows it through to the keeper.
Shikha Pandey comes back on.
On a length and around off, Perry gets an inside edge onto the her pads. Had she missed, she would have been an lbw candidate. Jhulan knows that and has her hands on head.
Good length ball on off, right on the money this time, Perry is solidly behind the line in defense.
FOUR! Cry of anguish by Goswami as she gets her line and length wrong on this occasion. A leg stump half-volley and Perry puts it away without any qualms to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Full in length and around off, Perry remains backward in defense. This is good tidy stuff by Jhulan.
On a length and around off, Ellyse stays on the back foot and pushes it to covers.
Full in length on off, angling in, Perry strides forward and defends it back.
Allows the full ball to spin back in and then pushes it to the off side. Successful over.
Quicker and fuller on middle and leg, Villani stays back to flick but misses.
FOUR! Good safe shot! Tossed up ball on middle, Villani takes the aerial route and goes over the bowler's head. He is down to the pitch in a flash and dismisses it for a boundary.
Floated full ball on off, Villani gets forward in defense.
Elyse Villani walks out to bat.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Flighted ball on off, skidding in probably, Bolton tries to drive through the line after stepping out but fails to get it away in the direction she would have liked to. It pops out from the toe end of the bat and Sharma in her followthrough takes a nice diving catch. Australia in dire straits with the top half removed in a jiffy. 261 needed off 208 balls!
Short and on off, it's cut from the back foot to backward point.
Deepti Sharma comes into the attack.
Hits the blockhole, Perry digs it out from the inner half of the bat.
Slower delivery, full and around off, Bolton slices her drive down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Short and punished. Bolton swivels on the back foot, fetches it from outside off and nails her pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Good length ball on off, Perry goes on the back foot and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a run. Pressure on Australia, not getting any momentum and the wickets haven't helped.
Tries to lure Perry by bowling a driving length delivery outside off, the Aussie all-rounder stays calm and lets it through to the keeper.
Bolton plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. A single taken.
Good length ball landing outside off, shaping back in, Perry sticks on the back foot in defense.
Wide outside off, on a length, it's left alone by Ellyse.
Around off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller on off, tried to flick but got an inside edge onto the pads. It rolled to covers.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings. Very full in length on middle, Perry gets across the stumps and flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Reaches out for a full ball outside off and drives it through point for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, going straight on with extra bounce, Perry shoulders arms.
Ellyse Perry is in next.

OUT! Goswami removes the big fish! Beauty of a delivery, she lands it on a length on off and gets it to straighten just a hint, Meg stays back to play inside the line but misses. The off stump has been disturbed and Jhulan jumps in joy. The Indian ladies are overjoyed, they know the importance of this wicket. Lanning was the linchpin of the Aussie batting and now the world champions are in real trouble.
Full and on off, Lanning rather than getting forward stays back in defense.
Good length delivery outside off, Bolton leans into the drive but it takes the outer half of the bat and runs down to third man. A single taken.
Another front foot drive by Bolton but she fails to beat the mid off fielder.
Leans forward to a full ball on off and drives it straight to mid off.
Some movement back into the right-hander from outside off, Lanning gets on the front foot and defends it watchfully. Top over!
Very full and on middle and off, Bolton walks down the track and drives it square of the wicket on the off side. Goes past backward point and she takes a single.
Lands it full and outside off, an uppish drive this time by Bolton but it goes safely to mid off. These dot balls will create pressure.
An overpitched ball outside off, a good looking cover drive by Nicole but she finds the fielder.
Full again, around leg, Bolton tries to flick but misses. It hits her pads, she looks for a leg bye but is sent back.
Fuller in length outside off, inviting the drive, Bolton does so but her shot doesn't have much timing or power.
Goes on the back foot and taps a length ball down towards point. Fantastic over by the ace bowler.
Beaten! Beautiful outswinger by Goswami, angling into the batsman and then leaving off the seam, Lanning flirts inside the line and gets beaten. Nearly edged it.
Pitches it full and on off, Lanning is on the front foot as she plays it with an angled bat to backward point.
On a length and outside off, shaping away, Bolton gets back and steers it through backward point for a single.
On a length and around middle, Nicole gets back inside the crease and helps it once again towards mid-wicket.
Too full in length on middle, some inward movement, Bolton gets forward and plays it off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Angles in a full ball on off, Meg presents a straight bat and offers a solid defense. End of a successful first over by Shikha!
Works it to wide of mid on and takes a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers. Slight misfield inside the ring but no run taken.
Excellent delivery, around middle and shaping down, Lanning fails to flick and it goes off her pads to long leg. A leg bye taken.
Skipper Meg Lanning walks in next.

OUT! Clattered! Great start for India as Pandey draws first blood. It's the wicket on in-form Mooney. A length ball on middle, 106 kph, Mooney plays all around a straightforward delivery by leaving a big gap between her bat and pad. Misses it completely and finds her off stump uprooted. The Indian girls are jubilant. A perfect start.
Fullish and around off, a hint of swing there, Mooney presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Shikha Pandey to speed in from the other end.
A back foot defense by Bolton to end the over. An eventful one by Goswami!
Good length ball on middle and leg, it's helped through backward square leg for a single.

Huge shout for an lbw! The umpire stays still. Excellent delivery by Goswami, lands it on a length around middle, Mooney fails to work it around on the leg side and is hit on the front pad. They appeal but the umpire turns it down. Dear me, it would have been gone on the review as Hawk Eye shows it to be hitting the top of the middle stump. India didn't opt for the DRS, otherwise Australia would have been one down.
Angling away from the batsman, on a length, Mooney plays from the back foot and taps it down to point. Straight to the fielder.
Once again it's fuller and straighter from Goswami, Bolton bunts it towards mid on and crosses for a hesitant single.
Too straight in line first up, Bolton closes the face of the bat and helps it through square leg for a couple of runs. Australia are away!

Back for the chase! Beth Mooney and Nicole Bolton are in form Australian opening pair. It's going to be Jhulan Goswami to kickoff proceedings with the new ball. A slip in place. All set, here we go...
